# IEEE8500 source-grid compatibility operating point

**FINAL_SOURCE_ALPHA_OPERATING_POINT_AUTHORITY**

Final (source_pu, alpha8500): **(1.045, 0.25)**. Selected date: **2025-05-21**.

The source grid {1.050, 1.045, 1.040, 1.035, 1.030}, alpha grid {1.00, 0.95, ..., 0.00}, code, hard criteria, lexicographic selection rule and input hashes were frozen before execution. All **105 cases / 10,080 chronological B0 slots** were freshly evaluated. The original failed source=1.050 stage was independently reproduced across all 21 alpha trajectories and remains immutable.

This is a reduced-load IEEE8500 study-envelope compatibility adaptation, **not canonical IEEE8500 reproduction**. Relative to the preceding adaptation, only source pu varies. All twelve regulator phase controls retain Vreg=125 V, PT ratio=60, band=2 V and original tap limits. CAPBank3 remains OFF; all nine controlled capacitor phases and CapControls, native impedances/topology/ratings, PCCs, 24-location registry and AIDC/MESS scales remain unchanged.

Every case uses a fresh engine context, MaxIterations=100, MaxControlIterations=1000, native snapshot control mode and 96 sequential snapshots with accepted tap/cap state carried within the day. Five isolated source workers run concurrently; completion order is irrelevant to selection. No control EventLog property is edited. Inputs are the same frozen causal D-1 VIC1 demand/PV profiles, B0 exogenous PV penetration ratio, native proportional phase allocation and AIDC P/Q trajectories; MESS commands remain zero. No Actual or B1/B2/B3 data are used.

| 1.050 | None | None | 2016 / 2016 |
| 1.045 | 0.25, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 0.00 | 0.25 | 2016 / 2016 |

Selection uses the **largest source with any feasible alpha**, then the **largest feasible alpha at that source**. It does not select a lower source merely to improve alpha. All grid points are evaluated, with no refinement or post-result tuning.

Hard limits: 0.95–1.05 pu at all 8639 nodes; line phase-current, transformer phase-current and transformer winding apparent-power loading ≤1.0 pu, with the unchanged 1e-9 numerical boundary tolerance. Both active line terminals and every transformer winding are included. Every slot must converge and settle controls.

Independent replay **PASS**: a separate clean process and fresh context completed all 96 chronological slots. All voltage/current/kVA axes were independently reconstructed using scalar bus/element APIs. Maximum phase-array difference: 1.39e-17 pu. Physical accepted tap/cap states match, and no unexpected static changes occurred.

All **2618 original evidence files** preserve SHA256, size and modification time. The previous NO_FEASIBLE_ALPHA_ON_FIXED_COMPATIBILITY_GRID result is untouched. Rule/code/input pre-execution hashes also remain unchanged.

B1/B2/B3 executions: **0**. Additional tuning outside the frozen grid: **0**.

Outputs: FINAL_OPERATING_POINT_AUTHORITY.json; SOURCE_GRID_SUMMARY.csv; SOURCE_ALPHA_SCREEN_TABLE.csv (105 cases); B0_10080_SLOT_EXTREMA.csv; per-case full phase arrays and control states under screen/; INDEPENDENT_REPLAY_VERIFICATION.json and independent_replay/; GRID_VALIDATION.json; IMMUTABILITY_FINAL_AUDIT.json; pre-execution and final SHA256 manifests.
